notable_absence.finding: The promoted registry's analytics:service-level-configuration-parameter and analytics:node-specific-configuration-parameter concepts state that EVERY classic Analytics setting requires the Cluster Restart API or the Node Restart API (or a reboot) to take effect. This page's --set for Enterprise Analytics BLOB storage settings states no restart requirement at all, anywhere - no mention of a restart endpoint, a rebalance, or any other activation step. Either BLOB-storage settings apply live (a genuine architecture simplification over classic Analytics config) or the restart requirement is simply undocumented here; the page alone cannot distinguish the two, which is itself notable given how emphatically the classic-Analytics restart requirement is stated elsewhere.

cross_component_finding: This page's settable surface (--partitions, --scheme, --bucket, --prefix, --region, --endpoint, --anonymous-auth, --path-style-addressing) is entirely object-storage/BLOB-tiering configuration and shares not one flag name with couchbase-cli-setting-analytics's single settable option, --replicas. This is the same finding the link-setup pair produced at the link-management layer, now repeated at the settings layer: 'Enterprise Analytics' and 'Analytics' are not the same backing feature under two names in this CLI tree - they are two different configuration models (object-storage-tiered vs replica-count-based) that happen to share a directory and a naming pattern.
cross_product_finding: As with the link-setup pair, there is no promoted or extraction-layer concept anywhere in the registry for 'Enterprise Analytics' prior to this record, so this page's settings vocabulary (partitions/scheme/bucket/prefix/anonymous-auth/path-style-addressing) cannot be checked for consistency against any REST or UI-side Enterprise Analytics settings page - this extraction is likely first contact with that surface for the whole POC. Separately: the CLI's boolean idiom throughout this page is a bare '<0|1>' integer flag (--anonymous-auth <0|1>, --path-style-addressing <0|1>), rather than the true/false or on/off vocabulary typical of REST JSON bodies elsewhere in the registry - a CLI-vs-REST representation-format difference distinct from, but of the same kind as, the terminology drift this round is watching for.
